Venue Biography

The Cathedral of Speed makes a welcome return to the British Superbike Championship after a 5-year hiatus, kicking off the Showdown for 2025. The track plays host to the world's best two-wheel circuit racers across the year, and is renowned by fans globally as one of the best for on-track action. A pilgrimage is expected for British fans travelling across the North Sea for the event, with DFDS offering exclusive discounts on their passenger ferries from Newcastle to Amsterdam, hoping to provide the town of Assen with an incredible atmosphere and the circuit with a capacity crowd come race day!
